# Blade & Blend Studio

> Public online appointment booking for a barbershop in Göteborg, Sweden.

Blade & Blend Studio is a single-page barbershop website. A visitor picks a barber, chooses a day and time, selects a service, and books an appointment online. The site is bilingual (Swedish by default, English available) and adapts between an editorial desktop layout and a Material-style mobile layout. The public site is a single page; public information pages describe privacy and booking terms. Staff routes require authentication and are not public content.

## Contact
- Current address, phone, staff, hours, and price range are generated from the public CMS data when served in production.

## Pages
- [Blade & Blend Studio](https://bladeblendstudio.se/): Home and online booking
- [Privacy Policy](https://bladeblendstudio.se/privacy): Data handling and Google Calendar disclosure
- [Booking terms](https://bladeblendstudio.se/terms): Booking, cancellation and contact
